description: This file defines the IWarehouse interface in the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including methods for hardware testing, reset operations, and notifications related to warehouse management.

classes.name: IWarehouse
classes.description: Interface for warehouse operations including hardware testing, reset, and data cleaning.

classes.name: IWarehouse::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for warehouse events such as reset completion.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for warehouse events.

methods.name: ExecuteHardwareTest
methods.description: Starts a hardware test on the device.

methods.name: GetHardwareTestResults
methods.description: Retrieves results of the last hardware test.

methods.name: InternalReset
methods.description: Reboots the warehouse service via internal reset script.

methods.name: IsClean
methods.description: Checks for customer data on the device.

methods.name: ResetDevice
methods.description: Resets the device to warehouse state.
